rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat up after supper talking about the journey, from the first night's camp to the last.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the road until the fire burned down to coals.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the long way home, and listened to all of it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] traded news: [RECIPIENT_nameDef]'s of the road, [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s of home.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the journey again, [detail].
detail->the river crossing twice
detail->with a map scratched in the dirt
detail->laughing about the worst night of it
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] walked the colony together, and the one who knew it best pointed out [thing].
thing->the good well and the bad one
thing->which door sticks in the damp
thing->where the spare blankets are kept
thing->the best spot to sit in the evening
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] where they'd come from, and they talked until supper.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] ate together and swapped the stories of how each of them ended up here.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] made room for [RECIPIENT_nameDef] at the table and filled [RECIPIENT_objective] in on who's who.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef], through gritted teeth, that [RECIPIENT_pronoun] had done good work.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] how [RECIPIENT_pronoun] did it. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] was too surprised not to answer.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked shop for a whole meal without a single argument.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] admitted to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that [RECIPIENT_pronoun] was better at it. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said "sometimes".
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] stopped glaring long enough to compare notes.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] finally talked about the old quarrel, and neither of them raised a voice.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] went to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] and said [INITIATOR_pronoun] was sorry for [INITIATOR_possessive] part in it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said the things they had been saving up, and then the things they meant.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked for a long time, out of everyone's way, and came back looking tired and easier.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] if they could start again. [RECIPIENT_nameDef] said they could try.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over a piece of work together, finger on every flaw.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] argued happily about the right way to [task].
task->finish an edge
task->start a piece
task->hold the tool
task->tell when a thing is done
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] watched [RECIPIENT_nameDef] work and said nothing for a long while, then one thing that mattered.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] took a piece apart to see where it went wrong, and put it back better.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about someone they lost, and for a while it was almost like having them back.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] a story about the dead that [RECIPIENT_nameDef] had never heard.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] remembered the dead out loud, the good and the annoying both.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] sat with [RECIPIENT_nameDef] and let [RECIPIENT_objective] talk about the one who is gone.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] laughed about something the dead used to do, and then went quiet.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] stood around awkwardly over a gift, one too shy to give it and the other too surprised to take it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the day one of them helped the other, and how it was never forgotten.
r_logentry->A gift changed hands between [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef], made by hand, with a few words about an old debt.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed they were square, then argued over who owed whom a drink.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked work, the young one asking a hundred questions and the older one answering most of them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] spent an hour on how a thing is done, and why, and then why again.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] let [RECIPIENT_nameDef] try it, standing close enough to catch a mistake.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the trade like it was the most important thing in the world. For one of them it is.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what the older of them knows, and who ought to have it next.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed on lessons, starting tomorrow, early.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] shook on it: the old hand would teach, and the young one would listen. Mostly.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the trade over supper, and by the end of the meal there was a teacher and a student at the table.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the last things worth knowing, the ones that aren't written anywhere.
r_logentry->Old tools changed hands between [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef], along with a story for each of them.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked late about the trade, and the old hand said there wasn't much left to teach.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] worked side by side in silence, and the older one didn't need to correct anything.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked in low voices for a long time, away from the others.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] walked out past the fields, and only one of them did most of the talking.
r_logentry->Something passed between [INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that neither of them will repeat.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] stopped talking when someone came in, and started again once they'd gone.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about a dream that keeps coming back, and what it might mean.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] went over the same dream piece by piece, as if it were a map.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] listened to [RECIPIENT_nameDef] describe the dream again, and had an idea about it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] agreed the dream wanted something. They argued over what.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about the old grudge, and whether it was worth carrying any further.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] asked [RECIPIENT_nameDef] what the one they lost would have wanted. Neither of them said revenge.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] sat a long while without saying much about the anger, and then said a lot.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked until the hard edge went out of it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about what one of them has been working toward, and how close it is.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] to stop doubting and keep going.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] counted up how far there was left to go. It was less than either of them thought.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] and [RECIPIENT_nameDef] talked about giving up, and decided not to.
